item.text: I’ll run the two read-only commands in the requested order and summarize their output in one sentence.

item.aggregated_output:
Headless CLI for reading/writing data and views

Usage: tonk <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init       Initialize a new repo in the current working directory
  identity   Show the local profile DID. With `--reset`, deletes the on-disk profile and creates a fresh identity
  eval       Evaluate commands in the current repo
  guide      Print the agent reference. With no topic, prints a one-screen index; `tonk guide <topic>` prints one section; `tonk guide all` prints everything. Useful for agent harnesses that need to learn the syntax without repo access
  schema     Print the current site's schema (every named attribute and concept) as a re-submittable notation document
  concepts   List user-defined concepts on the local branch. One row per concept, tab-separated `name<TAB>description`. Built-in concepts (`attribute`, `concept`, …) are omitted — they're resolvable everywhere and would just be noise
  views      List entities that carry a `text/html` claim on the local branch. One row per entity, tab-separated `name<TAB>entity<TAB>bytes`. Claim-driven: surfaces anything the host route would serve, regardless of how the claim was asserted
  migrate    Migrate a `.carry/` directory to `.tonk/`. Walks up from `$PWD` to find the source unless `--from` is supplied; the destination is always a sibling `.tonk/` of the source
  export     Export the local main branch's artifacts as CSV. Writes to stdout unless `--out <file>` is given
  render     Render a `<tonk-display>` view to HTML, headlessly
  import     Import artifacts from a CSV file, committing each row as an assertion on the local main branch
  push       Push the local main branch to its upstream
  pull       Pull the local main branch from its upstream
  status     Print how the local main branch relates to its upstream: `synced`, `ahead`, `behind`, `diverged`, or `no-upstream`. Read-only — fetches the upstream head without merging
  invite     Mint a UCAN delegation chain over the local repo and print a paste-able invite URL. The default form is audience-open: anyone holding the URL can claim by redelegating from the embedded ephemeral key
  join       Claim an invite URL into a fresh `.tonk/` under the current directory. Refuses if a site already exists
  remote     Manage remotes attached to the local repository
  share      Push to the upstream and produce a launcher URL that lands the recipient on a live view of local data
  telemetry  Show or change anonymous usage telemetry. `status` (default) prints the effective state and why; `on` / `off` persist the choice
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Start here:
  tonk guide            one-screen index
  tonk schema           every concept + attribute on the branch

Examples:
  tonk eval -c 'person:'
  tonk concepts
  tonk share display alice --view person-card
